data.long_meaning: From the Arabic roots 'Kai' meaning 'to be pure' and 'Han' meaning 'bright, radiant'. It is a name for a beautiful and pure soul. The name Keihana carries the meaning “Pure, Bright, Radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Keihana usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, bright, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
